messages:
anya: Quick sync — landing copy playbook for upcoming launch. Goal: one canonical set of microcopy that maps to Hosted / Dedicated / Private with clear CTA routing. I'll outline proposed pieces.
marcus: Love it. main asks?
sophia: Need benchmark narrative snippets for hero and subhead — we should quantify latency/cost tradeoffs, not just vague claims.
devon: For Dedicated page I'd add 'predictable throughput' line and a short bulleted micro-copy: `Reserved GPUs, predictable QPS`.
linh: Webinar hook: 20-min demo + 10-min Q&A. CTA on site should be "Register — see performance demo".
anya: Draft microcopy: Hero host: "Ship fast with our Hosted API — instant access to high-quality models with usage billing"; Dedicated hero: "Predictable inference at scale — reserved GPU pools and SLAs"; Private hero: "Bring inference behind your VPC — on-prem & KMS options". Thoughts?
marcus: Shorten hosted hero to avoid 'high-quality' fluff. Maybe: "Hosted API — instant, low-friction model access". Add a one-liner about benchmarks link.
sophia: I'll write the benchmark snippet: "Latency: 50–80ms p50 on typical LLMs; Cost: optimized using batching & KV caching — see benchmark PDF". Add link to /benchmarks (placeholder).
devon: For inbound lead routing: hosted leads -> marketing form + trial; dedicated -> SDR queue + capacity worksheet; private -> AE handoff + security questionnaire. We should ensure hidden form fields capture 'mode' selection.
linh: Webinar registration flow: add checkbox "I'm evaluating Dedicated/Private" so we can route leads accordingly.
anya: Good. For launch posts: three short variants — product, engineering, and solution angles. We'll coordinate copy across channels. Marcus will own the post cadence.
marcus: I can schedule posts. Need 3 assets: hero GIF showing latency, 30s clip for demo, and a one-pager (PDF) with benchmark tables.
sophia: Also add an eval prompt set for regression monitoring — link from pages to /evals/sample to encourage probing.
devon: QA: devex asked for exact token pricing callout? We should avoid specific numbers on page, link to pricing modal instead.
anya: Final ask: can everyone review the draft doc in Notion by EOD tomorrow? I'll assemble a content matrix with CTAs + routing after feedback. :thumbsup:
marcus: Reviewing now, will add scheduling notes.
launch-bot: Reminder: webinar slot reserved for 2026-04-07 16:00 UTC — event ID 98321.
linh: Great — I'll wire the registration CTA to the marketing form and add hidden field `evaluation_mode`.
anya: Thanks team — hitting Notion now.
